name: edutrack
description: Open the EduTrack desktop app from Claude Desktop.
long_description: Adds an 'open_edutrack' tool so you can ask Claude to start EduTrack, the desktop app for planning and tracking learning goals. EduTrack itself must be installed with EduTrack-0.1.0.msi.
